name: Orbital Economy v7.7.1 Transport Construction Materials candidate r1
description: v7.7.1 candidate: shared Transport expansion is backed by Construction Materials from A/B inventories, mirroring the accepted v7.5.1 shared Transport Capital Goods mechanism.

add_elements.name: Transport Construction Materials Enabled
add_elements.description: v7.7.1 master switch: shared Transport expansion physically requires Construction Materials.

add_elements.name: Transport Construction Materials per Capacity
add_elements.description: [calib] Construction Materials units consumed per unit of shared Transport capacity expansion.

add_elements.name: Transport Construction Materials Demand

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Transport Construction Materials Enabled] = 1, [Transport Desired Expansion] * [Transport Construction Materials per Capacity], 0)

add_elements.description: Physical Construction Materials demand generated by desired shared Transport expansion.

add_elements.name: Transport Construction Materials Source Inventory

behavior.value: [A Construction Materials Inventory] + [B Construction Materials Inventory]

add_elements.description: Combined A/B Construction Materials inventory available to shared Transport investment.

add_elements.name: Transport Construction Materials Fulfillment

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Transport Construction Materials Enabled] = 1, [Transport Construction Materials Source Inventory] / ([Transport Construction Materials Source Inventory] + [Construction Materials Buffer Days] * Max([Transport Construction Materials Demand], 0.000000001)), 1)

add_elements.description: Scale-free fulfillment factor for shared Transport Construction Materials demand, using the combined A/B source inventory.

add_elements.name: A Transport Construction Materials Source Share

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Transport Construction Materials Source Inventory] > 0.000000001, [A Construction Materials Inventory] / [Transport Construction Materials Source Inventory], 0.5)

add_elements.description: A share of actual Transport Construction Materials consumption, proportional to current regional inventory.

add_elements.name: B Transport Construction Materials Source Share

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Transport Construction Materials Source Inventory] > 0.000000001, [B Construction Materials Inventory] / [Transport Construction Materials Source Inventory], 0.5)

add_elements.description: B share of actual Transport Construction Materials consumption, proportional to current regional inventory.

add_elements.name: A Transport Construction Materials Demand Allocation

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Transport Construction Materials Enabled] = 1, [Transport Construction Materials Demand] * 0.5, 0)

add_elements.description: A production-planning half of shared Transport Construction Materials demand; actual consumption follows inventory shares.

add_elements.name: B Transport Construction Materials Demand Allocation

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Transport Construction Materials Enabled] = 1, [Transport Construction Materials Demand] * 0.5, 0)

add_elements.description: B production-planning half of shared Transport Construction Materials demand; actual consumption follows inventory shares.

add_elements.name: A Transport Construction Materials Consumption

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Transport Construction Materials Enabled] = 1, [Transport Capacity Expansion] * [Transport Construction Materials per Capacity] * [A Transport Construction Materials Source Share], 0)

add_elements.description: A regional contribution of Construction Materials physically consumed by shared Transport expansion.

add_elements.name: B Transport Construction Materials Consumption

behavior.value: IfThenElse([Transport Construction Materials Enabled] = 1, [Transport Capacity Expansion] * [Transport Construction Materials per Capacity] * [B Transport Construction Materials Source Share], 0)

add_elements.description: B regional contribution of Construction Materials physically consumed by shared Transport expansion.

add_elements.name: Transport Construction Materials Source Share Sum

behavior.value: [A Transport Construction Materials Source Share] + [B Transport Construction Materials Source Share]

add_elements.description: Diagnostic sum of A/B Transport Construction Materials source shares; equals 1 while source inventory is positive.

replace_formulas.name: Transport Capacity Expansion
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Transport Construction Materials Enabled] = 1, [Transport Desired Expansion] * Min([Transport Capital Goods Fulfillment], [Transport Construction Materials Fulfillment]), IfThenElse([Transport Capital Goods Enabled] = 1, [Transport Desired Expansion] * [Transport Capital Goods Fulfillment], (([Transport Gap Limited Construction]) + ([Transport Finance Limited Construction]) - (((([Transport Gap Limited Construction]) - ([Transport Finance Limited Construction])) ^ 2) ^ 0.5)) / 2))

replace_formulas.name: A Construction Materials Demand
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Transport Construction Materials Enabled] = 1, [A Refinery Desired Expansion] * [A Refinery Construction Materials per Capacity] + [A Electronics Desired Expansion] * [A Electronics Construction Materials per Capacity] + [A Power Desired Expansion] * [A Power Construction Materials per Capacity] + [A Transport Construction Materials Demand Allocation], [A Refinery Desired Expansion] * [A Refinery Construction Materials per Capacity] + [A Electronics Desired Expansion] * [A Electronics Construction Materials per Capacity] + [A Power Desired Expansion] * [A Power Construction Materials per Capacity])

replace_formulas.name: B Construction Materials Demand
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Transport Construction Materials Enabled] = 1, [B Refinery Desired Expansion] * [B Refinery Construction Materials per Capacity] + [B Electronics Desired Expansion] * [B Electronics Construction Materials per Capacity] + [B Power Desired Expansion] * [B Power Construction Materials per Capacity] + [B Transport Construction Materials Demand Allocation], [B Refinery Desired Expansion] * [B Refinery Construction Materials per Capacity] + [B Electronics Desired Expansion] * [B Electronics Construction Materials per Capacity] + [B Power Desired Expansion] * [B Power Construction Materials per Capacity])

replace_formulas.name: Test 2 Transport Surge Active
replace_formulas.value: IfThenElse([Timed Test Mode] = 2, [Temporary Test Window], IfThenElse([Timed Test Mode] = 24, [Temporary Test Window], IfThenElse([Timed Test Mode] = 31, [Temporary Test Window], 0)))
